data.title: 红月卡莲 · 霓虹雨巷的特勤皮衣回眸
data.description: 11区繁华都市细雨笼罩的暗巷中，两侧招牌的红蓝霓虹倒映在积水洼中。卡莲身穿短款修身皮夹克与黑色紧身裤，拉开拉链露出内衬背心。雨丝濡湿了她火红的发梢，她反手将手枪收入皮质枪套，转过身来警惕的目光在看清来人的一瞬间化为释然的浅笑，展现出冷艳干练的特工风采。
data.location: noir rain-soaked cyberpunk back alley with neon signage reflections
data.action: standing in wet neon alleyway, leather jacket unzipped over tank top, holstering sidearm, wet red hair, raindrops on skin, sharp affectionate smile
data.lighting: moody cyberpunk red and teal neon lighting reflecting on wet asphalt
data.mood: stylish noir grit, dangerous exhilarating undercover romance
data.promptProse: Standing in a rain-slicked neon alleyway, Kouzuki Kallen wears an open cropped leather jacket over a tank top. Raindrops glisten on her collarbones as she holsters a sidearm, turning with a sharp, loyal smirk.
data.animaCaption: Kallen standing in a rain-soaked neon alley in an open leather jacket, holstering her weapon.
